nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.confirmDelete: Delete node "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

services.catalogLabel: Available services — turn on what this node should do
services.orderLabel: Run order (drag to reorder; duplicate a service to run it more than once, e.g. buying fuel both before and after departing)

schedules.label: Schedule
schedules.specificHint: Runs at every picked minute of every picked hour — e.g. hours 6, 12 with minutes :00, :30 fires at 6:00, 6:30, 12:00, and 12:30.
schedules.advancedHint: Custom cron expression — doesn't match a simple "every N minutes" or "specific hours/minutes" pattern, so it's shown as-is.
schedules.hint: Multiple entries all trigger the same run — e.g. one for weekdays, one for weekends.

form.name: Name
form.gamePasswordEditPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current password
form.jitterHint: Random delay added after each trigger, before the run actually starts — makes login timing less mechanically regular. 0 disables it.
form.timezoneHint: Interprets every schedule entry above — one timezone for the whole node.
form.notReadyHint: This node needs a game login, password, and schedule before it can be enabled.
form.enabledHint: Toggling this only takes effect once you save — finish configuring below, then turn it on and save in one step.

advanced.intro: These only matter for the services you've turned on above — a greyed-out group belongs to a service you haven't enabled yet. Leave a field blank to use its default.
advanced.goodPriceFuelHint: Fuel price (per 1,000 Lbs) considered cheap enough to buy even when not critically low. Used by "buy_fuel". Default: 500.
advanced.goodPriceCo2Hint: CO2 price (per 1,000 Quotas) considered cheap enough to buy even when not critically low. Used by "buy_fuel". Default: 120.
advanced.fuelCriticalPercentHint: Below this remaining-fuel percentage, "buy_fuel" buys regardless of price. Default: 20.
advanced.budgetFuelHint: Percentage of your account balance "buy_fuel" is allowed to spend per run. Default: 70.
advanced.budgetMarketingHint: Percentage of your account balance the "marketing" service is allowed to spend on campaigns per run. Default: 70.
advanced.aircraftWearPercentHint: Aircraft wear percentage that triggers a bulk repair. Used by "ac_maintenance". Default: 80%.
advanced.aircraftMaxHoursToCheckHint: Triggers a bulk A-Check for any aircraft within this many hours of its next one. Used by "ac_maintenance". Default: 24.
advanced.aircraftModifyLimitHint: Caps how many aircraft "ac_maintenance" modifies in a single run (sorted by registration number). Default: 3.
advanced.hubsMaintenanceLimitHint: Caps how many hubs "hubs" repairs lounges in / buys catering for, per run. Default: 5.
advanced.budgetMaintenanceHint: Percentage of your account balance available for lounge repairs and catering ("hubs") AND aircraft repairs/A-Checks/modifications ("ac_maintenance") — both services draw from this same budget. Default: 30.
advanced.repairLoungesHint: Whether "hubs" repairs a hub's lounge when it needs it. Default: on.
advanced.buyCateringIfMissingHint: Whether "hubs" buys catering for a hub that has none. Turning this off also disables the two fields below. Default: on.
advanced.cateringDurationHoursHint: How many hours of catering "hubs" buys at a time, when buying catering is on. Default: 168h (one week).
advanced.cateringAmountOptionHint: How much catering "hubs" buys at a time, when buying catering is on. Default: 20000.
advanced.allianceIdsHint: Comma-separated list of numeric alliance IDs "alliance_stats" collects and exposes as Prometheus metrics for. Empty means none.
advanced.allianceIdsInvalidChar: Only digits, commas, and spaces are allowed.
